title: A Generalized $L^2$ Division Theorem and the Strong Openness Property of Multiplier Ideal Sheaves
summary: In this paper, we generalize Guan's sharp effective strong openness theorem to the case of several plurisubharmonic weights. The proof uses a generalized Skoda-type $L^2$ division theorem for multiplier ideal sheaves. We also discuss the relationships among the $L^2$-division theorem, the $L^2$-extension theorem and the effective openness theorem.
